title: Tech Note: Installing and Troubleshooting 4D Server - Macintosh

historical_commentary.text: This note is an installation and troubleshooting guide specific to 4D Server/Client v6 on classic Mac OS; its concrete installation steps and troubleshooting checks are entirely tied to a discontinued OS platform (System 7/8-era classic Mac OS) and a decades-old 4D Server release, making it obsolete as a practical how-to, though the general genre of "installation troubleshooting" documentation persists in modern 4D Server guides.
related_updates: Classic Mac OS (System 7/8, the platform this note targets) was discontinued by Apple in favor of Mac OS X in the early 2000s
4D Server's installation, licensing, and troubleshooting mechanisms have been completely redesigned many times over since 4D Server v6
